explication: Coze Loop is a platform for developing and operating AI agents. Its principal workflow spans prompt authoring and debugging, model-backed execution, systematic evaluation, and post-deployment observability; supporting capabilities include datasets, tools, and workspace foundations. The backend exposes these capabilities through API routing and service handlers. The README documents the product branches, while the sampled source is limited and does not establish most handler-to-domain wiring, so those internal links are omitted.
